info.sub_ename: GLOBAL CULTURAL CREATIVITY AND INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT

description.sub_ename: GLOBAL CULTURAL CREATIVITY AND INDUSTRIAL DEVELOPMENT
description.describe_ch: 針對文創產業做全面性說明與釐清。探討文化創意產業在全球不同國家的發展，聚焦各個國家特有的文化與創意如何發展成全球獨特產業的歷程，培養出具全球觀之文創分析與洞察能力，進而反思發掘自己的產業文創力。
description.describe_eh: This course will comprehensively explain and clarify the cultural and creative industry, so that students can understand the relevant issues of the cultural and creative industry. Meanwhile, this course will discuss the development of cultural and creative industries in different countries around the world. Let students understand the process of each country focusing on its unique culture and creativity to develop into a unique industry in global, cultivate cultural and creative analysis and insights with a global view, and then reflect on and explore our own industries with cultural and creative capabilities.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂上的行為始終應要及時、要專業、要做好準備、要有禮貌。同學、教師或其他講師間，應保有彼此尊嚴和相互尊重，才能進行有效的學習。為了確保有利於學習環境，冀望每個人都能做到以下幾點，彼此遵守課堂行為規則，習慣禮貌的文化。

學生應準時出席上課。如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。 除非您生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室，並坐在位子上。如果您有某種原因必須提早下課，請提前告知我。
所有學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以合理、負責和禮貌的態度行事。
上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除分組進行討論外，否則應盡量減少邊際對話。
當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
允許使用筆記型電腦或平板等載具，進行課堂記筆記，否則應將其收起。
要確保在上課時，關閉手機、PDA等移動設備，並收起及保持靜音。
不得戴耳機上課。
穿著整潔，不要暴露。
冀望以最高標準、互相尊重的專業對話模式，以多樣化和包容性，講述課程規則內容。
教師得以引導學生方式，學習過程中學生要做的事，應有的責任。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Behavior in the classroom should always be prompt, professional, prepared, and courteous. Students, teachers or other lecturers should maintain dignity and respect for each other in order to have effective learning. To ensure a conducive learning environment, everyone is expected to do the following, abide by the rules of classroom conduct and develop a culture of courtesy.

Students are expected to attend classes on time. If you cannot arrive on time during your class time, please do not choose the class. Unless you are sick or have an emergency, you should arrive on time and be seated before class starts. If you have to leave get out of class early for some reason, please let me know in advance.
All students are expected to treat everyone in the classroom with respect and behave reasonably, responsibly and courteously at all times.
Please do not talk, read, sleep, or do other non-course-related assignments during class. Marginal conversations should be minimized except for group discussions.
You should listen attentively when your classmates give presentations or ask questions. When you give a presentation, you should speak loudly to your group or to the class so that your classmates can hear you clearly.
The use of laptops, tablets and other devices for taking notes in class is allowed, otherwise they should be put away.
Make sure to turn off mobile phones, PDAs and other mobile devices during class, put them away and keep them silent.
Headphones are not allowed in class.
Dress neatly and not revealingly.
We hope to use the highest standards of professional dialogue with mutual respect to describe the content of the curriculum rules with diversity and inclusiveness.
Teachers can guide students' methods, what students should do during the learning process, and what responsibilities they should have.
​
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
學習必須以誠信為基礎，任何學生企圖將自己未製作的作品，作為自己的作品，此行為是為不誠實行為。
任何以您的名義提交的測試、論文或報告都被認為是您自己的原創作品，並且之前未曾在其他課程中提交過的作業、作品、或報告等，除非事先獲得我的批准。 在您的所有作業中，包括您的家庭作業或論文草稿，您可以引用其他人在出版物、網站或其他來源中撰寫的文字或想法，但必須註明出處。如果您對完成作業、或參加考試或考試的要求不清楚時，請務必事先向老師或TA尋求說明。最後，您應該記住，作為學生應該在所有學術活動中表現出誠信，完成學習任務。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Learning must be based on integrity. Any student who attempts to pass off work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest.
Any test, paper, or report submitted on your behalf is considered to be your own original work and has not been previously submitted in another course, unless approved in advance by me. In all your work, including your homework assignments or drafts of your thesis, you may quote words or ideas written by others in publications, websites, or other sources, but you must cite the source. If you are unclear about the requirements for completing an assignment, or taking a test or exam, be sure to seek clarification from your teacher or TA in advance. Finally, you should remember that as a student you are expected to demonstrate integrity in all academic activities and complete your academic assignments.
